kill_criterion.assumption: An external operator has an unmet rule worth testing; this is not yet observed.
kill_criterion.cheapest_test: Prepare an unsent synthetic-workload request and qualification packet; send only on a user-authorized permitted channel.
kill_criterion.pass_rule: One qualified operator packet: task, synthetic input, checker, current method, unmet rule, dependencies and bounds. This reopens C3; it does not prove production readiness.
kill_criterion.fail_rule: Seven days after an actual authorized invitation, no qualified packet; classify no-send, no-reply and incomplete replies separately.
kill_criterion.stop_rule: No integration work if current method meets the rule, requirements are unsupported, permission is absent, or the scoped two-hour fit budget expires.
